text:
marta: FYI ran into a parity surprise converting our onboarding sample from curl -> python sdk. A couple of things: headers we set in env arent making it through, and the SDK is retrying idempotent and non-idempotent calls the same way.

diego: which headers? can you paste the minimal repro?

marta: setting TRACE_ID and X-Client-TTL in the example env vars. curl shows them on the server, python sdk request doesn't. Example curl:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Client-TTL: 15" -H "TRACE_ID: onboarding-123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate -d '{"model":"lite-1","input":"hi"}'
```

marta: python sdk snippet:```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(os.environ['RW_KEY'])
client.text.generate(model='lite-1', input='hi')
```

sasha: python sdk currently filters headers for security (we started whitelisting). But TRACE_ID/X-Client-TTL should be allowed. Looks like the whitelist is out of date.

marta: second issue: I triggered a transient 502 on a non-idempotent /v1/text/generate and SDK retried twice, resulting in duplicate outputs in our demo chat. curl didnt retry.

diego: do we have a per-request option to disable retries?

sasha: there is an env flag REDWOOD_PY_SDK_RETRIES but it's global and not documented in quickstart. Ideally we expose disable_retries on the request and honor idempotency.

marta: workarounds I used: 1) call via requests.post to the REST endpoint to preserve headers and avoid SDK retries, 2) set REDWOOD_PY_SDK_RETRIES=0 in my demo env. Both are annoying for an onboarding flow.

infra-bot: Created issue #612: "python sdk: header whitelist missing TRACE_ID/X-Client-TTL; default retry policy retries non-idempotent generate calls" https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/612

diego: proposed plan: 1) sasha to add TRACE_ID/X-Client-TTL to whitelist + unit test; 2) add per-call option `disableRetries=True` and make generate default to non-retry unless `idempotency_key` present; 3) quickstart note about env toggles.

sasha: will open PR for whitelist and per-call option. Can we cut a patch release after tests?

diego: yes, cut 0.10.1 patch if PR ready. Also update quickstart snippets to show the env toggle and a short paragraph on idempotency.

marta: thanks, this blocked our new-hire demo earlier. I'll add a tiny FAQ entry under devex onboarding.

sasha: adding a small integration test to CI that runs the quickstart with headers set and asserts server saw TRACE_ID.

marta: perfect — appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
